title: S-Valve vs Gate Valve on a Trailer Concrete Pump
seoTitle: S-Valve vs Gate Valve Concrete Pump | Pinjin Wear Parts
description: Marketplace listings flag S-valve vs slide-gate. Pinjin pump pages do not print a valve-type column. Xingtai wear parts are the S-valve family: S-tube seals, swing-arm balls, pistons. Not other-brand OEM.
primaryKeyword: S-valve vs gate valve concrete pump

relatedPaths.label: Concrete pump spare parts and wear parts

answerBlock.what: An S-valve (S-tube) is a swinging distribution tube between the two pumping cylinders and the outlet. Slide-gate / pendulum listings on marketplaces are a different valve family. Pinjin trailer pump pages do not print a ‘valve type’ cell. The parts hub does: pipeline parts and S-valve wear parts — S-tube seals, swing-arm balls, pistons, springs. Those are Xingtai replacements. Confirm outer diameter on the pump; they are not OEM parts of other brands.
answerBlock.who: Buyers comparing Alibaba ‘S-valve’ filters, or service teams replacing a cutting ring / S-tube seal on a listed Pinjin trailer.
factors: Pump pages: no valve-type column — do not invent one
Parts hub: S-valve wear family, quoted by OD and quantity
ACI 304.2R discusses hydraulically powered directional valves vs ball-valve pumps as equipment classes
No small-batch parcels; no list price

faqs.question: Does Pinjin print S-valve or gate valve on each pump specification table?
faqs.answer: No. Trailer pump pages list power, output, pressure, hopper, distance, aggregate and size. Valve type is not a published cell. The spare-parts hub states that wear parts are the S-valve family. Do not copy an Alibaba ‘S-valve’ badge onto a blank cell.

faqs.question: Are Pinjin S-tube seals OEM parts for other pump brands?
faqs.answer: No. They are Xingtai replacement wear parts. Send part name, outer diameter or kit, and quantity. Not sold in small batches; no published list price.

faqs.question: Is a gate-valve or pendulum-valve trailer listed in the catalogue?
faqs.answer: No such SKU name is listed. Marketplace filters for gate / pendulum valves are a search observation. We quote listed trailers and listed S-valve wear parts only.
